# Name Part

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:NamePart`](gmeow-NamePart.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/NamePart>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/names`](../../slices/names.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A reified component of a structured appellation — a given name, a surname, a patronymic, a nobiliary particle, an Arabic nisba, a filename extension. Its kind is the value [`gmeow:namePartType`](../properties/gmeow-namePartType.md), its text is [`gmeow:partText`](../properties/gmeow-partText.md), and [`gmeow:partOrder`](../properties/gmeow-partOrder.md) records its position WITHOUT implying a Western given-before-family order.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:NamePart`](gmeow-NamePart.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to decompose an appellation into its typed, ordered components when parts must be matched, expanded, or rendered separately — a given name, surname, patronymic, particle, Arabic nisba, or filename extension.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using [`gmeow:partOrder`](../properties/gmeow-partOrder.md) to encode a given-before-family default (it records the culture's actual surface order, so East-Asian family-first is simply order 0 = surname) and avoid reassembling the display form from parts — [`gmeow:fullName`](../properties/gmeow-fullName.md) is authoritative for that.

### How to use

- Mint one [`NamePart`](gmeow-NamePart.md) per component, set [`gmeow:namePartType`](../properties/gmeow-namePartType.md), [`gmeow:partText`](../properties/gmeow-partText.md) (language-/script-tagged), and [`gmeow:partOrder`](../properties/gmeow-partOrder.md), add [`gmeow:partExpansion`](../properties/gmeow-partExpansion.md) for an abbreviated initial, and attach it with [`gmeow:hasNamePart`](../properties/gmeow-hasNamePart.md).

### Examples

- ex:yamadaPart a [`gmeow:NamePart`](gmeow-NamePart.md); [`gmeow:namePartType`](../properties/gmeow-namePartType.md) [`gmeow:namePartSurname`](../individuals/gmeow-namePartSurname.md); [`gmeow:partText`](../properties/gmeow-partText.md) "山田"; [`gmeow:partOrder`](../properties/gmeow-partOrder.md) 0.
